text: Lipicanci, ponos kobilarne Lipica, se skotijo temni. Kakšni postanejo večinoma, ko odrastejo?
gloss: Lipizzaners are born dark. What colour do most become as adults? — White: their coat greys to white over several years.

text: Na otoku katerega jezera stoji cerkev, v kateri obiskovalci pozvonijo z zvonom želja?
gloss: On the island of which lake is the church where visitors ring the wishing bell? — Lake Bled.

text: Kateri pustni lik v kosmatem ovčjem kožuhu in z zvonci za pasom po ljudskem verovanju odganja zimo?
gloss: Which carnival figure in a shaggy sheepskin with bells on his belt drives winter away? — Kurent, the Ptuj carnival figure.

text: Prekmurska gibanica ima plasti maka, skute in orehov. Iz katerega sadja je še četrta?
gloss: Prekmurska gibanica has poppy seed, cottage cheese and walnut layers. What fruit is the fourth? — Apples.

text: Kateri ansambel je zaslovel s skladbo „Na Golici“, ki jo poznajo po vsem svetu?
gloss: Which band became famous with the tune "Na Golici"? — The Avsenik Brothers Ensemble (Slavko Avsenik composed it).

text: Katero dirko je Tadej Pogačar prvič osvojil leta 2020?
gloss: Which race did Tadej Pogačar first win in 2020? — The Tour de France (his Tour of Slovenia win came first in 2019, the Giro in 2024).

text: Kdo je zlobnež, ki se ga bojijo vsi otroci v Vandotovih zgodbah o Kekcu?
gloss: Who is the villain all children fear in Vandot's Kekec stories? — Bedanec (Kosobrin is a kindly old man, Rožle Kekec's friend, Brdavs the giant from Martin Krpan).

text: Katera od teh besed ima samo množino, četudi govorimo o enem samem kosu oblačila?
gloss: Which of these words exists only in the plural, even for a single garment? — Hlače (trousers): "ene hlače"; the others have a singular.

text: Zakaj steklenica, polna vode, v zamrzovalniku poči?
options: Ker se voda, ko zmrzne, razširi
Ker se steklo na mrazu zdrobi
Ker je led težji od vode
gloss: Why does a bottle full of water burst in the freezer? — Water expands by about 9% when it freezes (ice is lighter, not heavier, than water).

text: Kateri iglavec vsako jesen porumeni in odvrže iglice?
gloss: Which conifer turns yellow and sheds its needles every autumn? — The larch.

text: Kaj izbrizgne hobotnica, ko hoče zmesti plenilca in zbežati?
gloss: What does an octopus squirt to confuse a predator and escape? — Ink.

text: S katero sosedo ima Slovenija najdaljšo kopensko mejo?
gloss: With which neighbour does Slovenia share its longest land border? — Croatia (about 670 km, roughly twice the Austrian border).

text: Majhna Andora leži v Pirenejih med Francijo in katero državo?
gloss: Tiny Andorra lies in the Pyrenees between France and which country? — Spain.

text: Katero valuto je Slovenija leta 2007 zamenjala z evrom?
gloss: Which currency did Slovenia replace with the euro in 2007? — The tolar.

text: Katera vladarska rodbina je do leta 1918 več stoletij vladala večini slovenskih dežel?
gloss: Which ruling house governed most Slovene lands for centuries until 1918? — The Habsburgs; the Counts of Celje were a rival local house that died out in 1456.

text: Iz katerega jezika izhaja beseda origami, umetnost prepogibanja papirja?
gloss: Which language does the word origami, the art of paper folding, come from? — Japanese (oru "fold" + kami "paper").

text: Kateri angleški igralec je upodobil molčečega gospoda Beana?
gloss: Which English actor played the near-silent Mr. Bean? — Rowan Atkinson.

text: Kateri risani maček obožuje lazanjo in sovraži ponedeljke?
gloss: Which cartoon cat loves lasagne and hates Mondays? — Garfield.

text: Iz katere države prihajajo kocke LEGO?
gloss: Which country do LEGO bricks come from? — Denmark (Billund).

text: Katera brezžična povezava na kratke razdalje poveže telefon z brezžičnimi slušalkami?
gloss: Which short-range wireless link connects a phone to wireless earbuds? — Bluetooth; USB and HDMI are cables, Wi-Fi joins networks.

text: Iz katere stročnice je narejen bližnjevzhodni namaz humus?
gloss: Which pulse is the Middle Eastern spread hummus made from? — Chickpeas.

text: Kateri nordijski bog vihti kladivo Mjölnir?
gloss: Which Norse god wields the hammer Mjölnir? — Thor.

text: V katerem športu je Janja Garnbret postala olimpijska prvakinja?
gloss: In which sport did Janja Garnbret become Olympic champion? — Sport climbing (Tokyo 2020 and Paris 2024).

text: Katera bajeslovna žival stoji na grajskem stolpu v grbu Ljubljane?
gloss: Which mythical creature stands on the castle tower in Ljubljana's coat of arms? — A dragon.

text: Ura kaže 14.15. Kako to po domače povemo?
gloss: The clock shows 14:15. How do we say it colloquially? — "Četrt na tri": Slovenian counts quarters towards the coming hour (pol treh = 14:30, četrt na dve = 13:15).

text: Katera beseda pomeni »jaz in še ena oseba«?
gloss: Which word means "I and one other person"? — Midva, the dual of "we"; mi is three or more, vidva "you two", onadva "they two".

text: Kaj izmerimo z Richterjevo lestvico?
gloss: What does the Richter scale measure? — The strength (magnitude) of an earthquake.

text: Katera skupina je Slovenijo na Evroviziji 2023 zastopala s pesmijo »Carpe Diem«?
gloss: Which band represented Slovenia at Eurovision 2023 with "Carpe Diem"? — Joker Out.

text: S katerim klubom je Luka Dončić pri devetnajstih letih osvojil evroligo?
gloss: With which club did Luka Dončić win the EuroLeague at nineteen? — Real Madrid, in 2018, as the Final Four MVP.

text: Koliko je poldrugi liter?
gloss: How much is "poldrugi" litre? — 1.5 l: "half of the second" litre, i.e. one and a half.

text: Kateri organ izdeluje žolč?
gloss: Which organ produces bile? — The liver; the gallbladder only stores it.

text: Kje je vrelec Geysir, po katerem so poimenovani vsi gejzirji?
gloss: Where is the spring Geysir that gave all geysers their name? — Iceland.

text: Kdo je po grški bajki bogovom ukradel ogenj in ga podaril ljudem?
gloss: In Greek myth, who stole fire from the gods and gave it to people? — Prometheus.

text: Katera draga začimba so posušene nitke iz cvetov posebne vrste krokusa?
gloss: Which costly spice is the dried threads from the flowers of a kind of crocus? — Saffron (the stigmas of Crocus sativus).

text: Katero ljudstvo je visoko v Andih zgradilo Machu Picchu?
gloss: Which people built Machu Picchu high in the Andes? — The Incas.

text: Kdo je napisal povest Cvetje v jeseni?
gloss: Who wrote the novella Cvetje v jeseni (Flowers in Autumn)? — Ivan Tavčar (1917).

text: Katera pisateljica je ustvarila belgijskega detektiva Hercula Poirota?
gloss: Which writer created the Belgian detective Hercule Poirot? — Agatha Christie.

text: Koliko robov ima kocka?
gloss: How many edges does a cube have? — 12: four on top, four on the bottom, four upright (6 is faces, 8 vertices).

text: Stari slovenski mesec vinotok je dobil ime po trgatvi in mladem vinu. Kateri mesec je to?
gloss: The old Slovenian month name vinotok comes from the grape harvest and new wine. Which month is it? — October (September is kimavec, November listopad).

text: Za katero angleško besedo stoji črka „s“ v https na začetku spletnih naslovov?
gloss: Which English word does the "s" in https stand for? — Secure.

text: Kaj po stari šegi na cvetno nedeljo nesemo k blagoslovu?
gloss: What is traditionally taken to be blessed on Palm Sunday? — A butara, the bundle of greenery.

text: Katera riba se iz morja vrne drstit v reko, v kateri se je izlegla?
gloss: Which fish returns from the sea to spawn in the river where it hatched? — The salmon (the eel does the opposite, spawning at sea).

text: Kateri slovenski impresionist je dal v Ljubljani zgraditi razstavni paviljon, ki je nosil njegovo ime?
gloss: Which Slovenian impressionist had an exhibition pavilion built in Ljubljana that bore his name? — Rihard Jakopič (Jakopičev paviljon, 1909).

text: Kateri je bil prvi slovenski celovečerni zvočni film, posnet leta 1948?
gloss: What was the first Slovenian feature-length sound film, made in 1948? — Na svoji zemlji (On Our Own Land), by France Štiglic.

text: Nad vrati stare hiše je vklesana letnica MDCCC. Katero leto je to?
gloss: The year MDCCC is carved above an old door. Which year is it? — 1800: M 1000 + D 500 + CCC 300.

text: Kateri živalski skupini pripada človeška ribica iz kraških jam?
gloss: Which animal group does the olm of the Karst caves belong to? — Amphibians, despite its Slovenian name "human fish".

text: Ko je v Ljubljani poldne, koliko je ura v Londonu?
gloss: When it is noon in Ljubljana, what time is it in London? — 11:00: London is one hour behind all year, as both switch to summer time on the same days.

text: V katero morje se na koncu izlije voda iz Ljubljanice?
gloss: Which sea does the water of the Ljubljanica finally reach? — The Black Sea: Ljubljanica → Sava → Danube.

text: Kateri v Ljubljani rojeni kemik je leta 1923 prejel Nobelovo nagrado za mikroanalizo organskih snovi?
gloss: Which Ljubljana-born chemist won the 1923 Nobel Prize for the microanalysis of organic substances? — Fritz (Friderik) Pregl.

text: Po zakonu Jožefa Stefana je moč, ki jo izseva telo, sorazmerna s katero potenco njegove absolutne temperature?
gloss: By Jožef Stefan's law, the power a body radiates is proportional to which power of its absolute temperature? — The fourth (Stefan–Boltzmann law, P ∝ T⁴).
